analogy.rationale: Antiarrhythmics target cardiac ion channels (KCNA5, KCNH2) and beta-adrenergic receptors (ADRB1/2), but these channels and receptors are expressed at low levels in the tested cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; other ion-channel blockers and adrenergic antagonists may show modest overlap through shared off-target effects.
